subject: Remediation overflow for CheckVibe findings
body:
Hi CheckVibe team,

I saw CheckVibe's scanner, MCP server, and affiliate program for vibe-coded app security. The scanner side is strong, but a lot of nontechnical founders will still get stuck after they see a finding and need someone to turn the report into an actual fix.

I built a small manual exposure-check and rescue offer around that gap:
https://tatelyman.github.io/tate-web-services/vibe-leak-check.html
Sample report format: https://tatelyman.github.io/tate-web-services/vibe-exposure-sample.html

I am interested in a practical partner setup: I can refer founders to CheckVibe for scanning/monitoring, and if users need low-cost remediation after a report, I can take scoped cleanup tasks under a clear boundary: authorized apps only, normal-flow/repo/config review, no invasive testing, concise fix notes or patch work.

A good first experiment could be a small "need help fixing this?" referral path for users who get high/critical findings but do not know how to apply the AI fix prompts safely.

If that is useful, I can start with a few discounted remediation slots and report back on what users actually ask for.

Tate Lyman
https://tatelyman.github.io/tate-web-services/
lymantate2@gmail.com
